rationale.A: Viikki, Vallila valley and Central Park paths; only 90 m on Pasilansilta with tram rails; 6 lights
rationale.B: Kumpula variant of A with the same Pasilansilta tram stretch; Kustaa Vaasan tie crossing
rationale.C: Vallila valley, Pasila via Junailijankuja and Central Park; no mixed traffic at all, 4 lights, +3 min
rationale.D: Northern route mostly on side paths beside Mäkitorpantie, Metsäläntie and Asesepäntie; 7 lights
rationale.E: Northern route into Central Park (Keskuspuistontaival); some side paths; +5 min
rationale.F: Through Kallio/Alppila on side tracks beside Sturenkatu/Aleksis Kiven katu (tram); 12 lights
rationale.G: Maunula residential streets with Metsäpurontie in traffic, then Central Park; +8 min
rationale.H: Long side paths beside Pakilantie/Nuijamiestentie and Hirsipadontie in traffic; +9 min

notes: Close call. A is already mostly car-free; C's only gain is dropping the 90 m tram-rail stretch on Pasilansilta for +3 min. Under the 'tier-E stretch disappears' rule it qualifies, but the gain is small. Fewest lights: C saves 2 lights for 3 min, not enough.
